systems.country_label: EMIS; its yearly output is the Annuaire Statistique
systems.owner: Ministry of education (MENRS); the cleaning, updating and back-up of its database were taken on by UNESCO under a donor programme
systems.tiers: central database producing a report by August of each year; schools to be given a unique identification code and geo-tagged

systems.owner: Ministry of education, under the World Bank's Early Grade Learning Project
systems.tiers: pilot: 40 municipal inspectors capturing monthly data from a sample of 200 schools, for six of nine months in 2020/21 and 2021/22

note: The EMIS is described only through its yearly report and its database of schools, and the monthly tablet survey was keyed by inspectors for a 200-school sample; neither is a record per learner that schools add to, so there is no fact.
